title: Section 3 test
intro: Lessons 15 to 21. Three short parts: match words, fill a gap, then finish a conversation. Pass with 70% or higher.

parts.title: Part 3 · Conversation
parts.intro: Pick the line that fits the scene.

questions.question: pravo
questions.explanation: In directions, pravo means straight ahead.

questions.question: Dobar tek!
questions.explanation: Dobar tek is what you say when food arrives.

questions.question: igram
questions.explanation: Igram means I play. Gledam means I watch.

questions.question: ko
questions.explanation: Ko asks who. Šta asks what.

questions.question: Idi _____, pa lijevo.
questions.explanation: Idi pravo, pa lijevo means go straight, then left.

questions.question: Treba mi _____.
questions.explanation: Treba mi karta means I need a ticket.

questions.question: _____, molim.
questions.explanation: Račun, molim asks for the bill at a restaurant.

questions.question: Moj hobi je _____.
questions.explanation: Moj hobi je šetnja names walking as a hobby.

questions.question: Ana: Gdje je most? Emir: _____.
questions.explanation: A where-question wants a direction. Idi pravo, pa lijevo is go straight, then left.

questions.question: Clerk: Jednosmjerna ili povratna? Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: The clerk asks one-way or return. Jednosmjerna karta, molim buys a one-way ticket.

questions.question: Waiter: Izvoli. Emir: _____.
questions.explanation: When the food arrives, Dobar tek! is the right toast.

questions.question: Phone: Ko je tamo? Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: Ko je tamo? asks who is calling. You answer with your name.
